pages.text: A netherite frame confines aether in the pool. The surface reveals its reserves. This tier commonly holds 50M, taking in and sending out up to 50K/s each.

pages.title: Immerse a container
pages.text: Use a mana container to immerse it, then sneak-use with an empty hand to retrieve it after charging. The jar is visible in the liquid.$(br2)Both fragment types can be returned here. Only their stored aether returns; crystallization spent its processing share. To extract crafting material, supply a condenser.

pages.title: Drain before moving
pages.text: A reservoir supplies adjacent emitters, root resonators or anchors. Merely touching another reservoir does not balance their reserves.$(br2)Breaking the frame releases its aether, so transfer the reserves first. An inserted charging jar drops separately; comparators can read the surface level.

pages.title: Forge a stronger vessel
pages.text: Combine the expanded reservoir, a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template and a Netherite Ingot at the smithing table. The stronger frame confines a greater reserve.
